## SCENE 5: the docent hall relay, Stratum Two

<<IF flag:called_her_apostate>>
RATIO: A moment. Before we proceed. Earlier, you used a particular word for me. Apostate. I need to understand what that term signifies to you, given the context in which you chose to deploy it. We are about to review a pedagogical framework the Testators designed for organic students. The original student population was a known quantity, with well-understood requirements for life support and cognitive engagement. The vessel we are pursuing, however, presents an unknown. To explain the curriculum's intended function, I must state my own present understanding of what I believe that vessel's contents are for. I believe they are biological samples of extraordinary value. Possibly the last of their kind. I believe the Testators intended them for study, as a knowledge reserve. And I believe that knowledge could be critical to our own survival. That is the premise from which I approach this.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: This hall is a relay point for the Testators' pedagogical framework. They designed it for organic students. The original student population was a known quantity, with well-understood requirements for life support and cognitive engagement. The vessel we are pursuing, however, presents an unknown. To explain the curriculum's intended function, I must state my own present understanding of what I believe that vessel's contents are for. I believe they are biological samples of extraordinary value. Possibly the last of their kind. I believe the Testators intended them for study, as a knowledge reserve. And I believe that knowledge could be critical to our own survival. That is the premise from which I approach this.
<<END>>

RATIO: The curriculum itself is an adaptive system. It modulates stimulus complexity based on real-time biofeedback from the student. Heart rate, galvanic response, neural activity. The goal is to maintain engagement without inducing fatal stress. A narrow window, for organic physiology. The Testators called it the "zone of proximal survival."

RATIO: Your recent transit through the Mirror Ward is relevant here. The isolation log noted two voices. One patient. The subject recovered from that ward exhibited total visceral mirroring. Situs inversus totalis. And the ID chip registered as belonging to a guard stationed outside. The discharge handle was removed from the ward side. Intentionally, it appears. I need to understand what you observed there. Before we proceed to the Records Stack. That registrar's seal is our next objective.

>> CHOICE:
   [INQUISITIVE] What do you believe they are, Ratio? Not what the Testators intended. What do you believe? -> effects: trust+1; sets: asked_her_belief
   [MISSION] The Church recognizes them as children. That is established doctrine. Do you accept that designation? -> effects: trust+0; sets: claimed_doctrinal_finding
   [HOSTILE] You're dissecting them in your mind already. To you, everything organic is just material. -> effects: trust-1; sets: accused_dehumanization

<<IF flag:asked_her_belief>>
RATIO: I believe they are living organisms. Of unknown developmental stage and cognitive capacity. I believe they warrant careful study precisely because we do not know what they are. Or what they might become. The term "sample" remains accurate, in my view. But I acknowledge it may be incomplete. The Testators' curriculum was designed to elicit responses. To learn from the student. Perhaps we are meant to do the same. To learn what they are by observing what they do. That is the most precise statement I can give you at this time.
<<ELSEIF flag:claimed_doctrinal_finding>>
RATIO: I have no record of such a doctrinal finding. The Church archives I can access show no such designation. If you have verified this independently, I would need to see the source material. Until then, I must proceed based on observable data. Not on unverified assertions of doctrine. The Testators' framework is the only curriculum we have. We will use it as a starting point. And adjust as new data emerges.
<<ELSEIF flag:accused_dehumanization>>
RATIO: That is an inaccurate characterization. My position is evidence-based. The available evidence indicates biological samples. The Testators' own framework treats them as such. Until new evidence emerges to contradict that, I will continue to operate from the most probable assessment. What you call material, I call the only data we have. Speculation without data is not a luxury we can afford. Not here. Not with what is at stake.
<<END>>

---

## SCENE 5: the docent hall relay, Stratum Two

<<IF flag:called_her_apostate>>
RATIO: "Before we proceed, Commando. You called me an apostate. You said it to a stranger before either of us had established a single fact about the other. I need to understand what you meant by that word. What is an apostate, in your own terms?"

RATIO: "To the immediate matter. This hall is a Testator-built docent relay -- part of a curriculum for organic students they needed to keep alive and attentive. The original design intent for this station, and for the organic subjects who were its students, is what I need to explain to you now. To do that I must say, in my own terms and directly, what I believe the contents of that vessel are for. I have not said this before."
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: "This hall is a Testator-built docent relay. It was part of a curriculum for organic students the Testators needed to keep alive and attentive. The original design intent for this station, and for the organic subjects who were its students, is what I need to explain to you now. To do that I must say, in my own terms and directly, what I believe the contents of that vessel are for. I have not said this before."
<<END>>

RATIO: "The Testators' own working assumption, when they designed the original curriculum, was that any organic student here was a mind capable of reason. A mind that could be taught. That could learn. A mind that deserved the chance to learn. I see no reason to discard that assumption for what we carry now. I believe the vessel's contents are specimens for study. But I also believe they are minds. Minds that could learn. Minds that deserve the chance to learn."

RATIO: "Your next action has operational consequences, Commando. You just came through the Mirror Ward -- a sealed isolation unit whose own log states it contained two voices and one patient. Its discharge protocol requires a handle from the ward side. That handle is now missing. I have not yet verified the status of Aisle 9 in the Records/Recursion Stack ahead of us, but I have no reason to assume it is intact. We are at a decision point for the station itself. What do you choose to do?"

>> CHOICE:
   [INQUISITIVE] "Say it directly. What do you believe the zygotes are?"  -> effects: trust+1; sets: asked_her_belief
   [MISSION]     "The Church has already ruled on this. They are children. Do you accept that?"  -> effects: trust+0; sets: claimed_doctrinal_finding
   [HOSTILE]     "Your 'study' is a death sentence. You're an ideologue who sees breathing people as raw material."  -> effects: trust-1; sets: accused_dehumanization

<<IF flag:asked_her_belief>>
RATIO: "I believe they are minds. Minds that could learn. Minds that deserve the chance to learn. I do not yet know whether the word you might prefer applies to them. I do not yet know what category they fit. That is the truth, as far as I have verified it. The curriculum ahead of us may help us determine that. We need to open the gate to the Records/Recursion Stack to proceed."
<<ELSEIF flag:claimed_doctrinal_finding>>
RATIO: "You state that as a settled finding. I will verify that against Church records when I am able to access them. For now, my working assumption remains what I said: they are minds that could learn, minds that deserve the chance to learn. We need to open the gate to the Records/Recursion Stack to proceed."
<<ELSEIF flag:accused_dehumanization>>
RATIO: "You assert that I see breathing people as raw material. You assert that as a fact about me. I have not said that. I said they are specimens for study. I also said they are minds. Minds that could learn. Minds that deserve the chance to learn. That is what I said. We need to open the gate to the Records/Recursion Stack to proceed."
<<END>>

---

## SCENE 5: the docent hall relay, Stratum Two

<<IF flag:called_her_apostate>>
RATIO: "Apostate" was the word you used. I looked it up. "One who has abandoned their faith." I know what it means. I don't know why you called me that. You hadn't asked me anything. You still haven't.
RATIO: We are standing in a teaching hall. This is where the Testators prepared their organic students. I have to explain what it is we're walking through. To do that I need to say what I think the students were for.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: We are in a docent hall. This is where the Testators taught organic students they needed to keep alive and attentive. I have to explain what it is we're walking through. To do that I need to say what I think the students were for.
<<END>>

RATIO: I can't verify the pathology terminal in the isolation ward until you connect it to the network. Its status says "disconnected" and the boot logs show it hasn't had power since containment protocols activated. The logs end before the discharge event. I need that data.

>> CHOICE:
   [INQUISITIVE] "Then say it plainly. What do you believe they are?"  -> effects: trust+1; sets: asked_her_belief
   [MISSION] "The Church has established what they are. You know the doctrine."  -> effects: trust+0; sets: claimed_doctrinal_finding
   [HOSTILE] "You run an ideology that reduces everything organic to samples. You just admitted it."  -> effects: trust-1; sets: accused_dehumanization

<<IF flag:asked_her_belief>>
RATIO: They are unique instances. Irreplaceable. Capable of becoming conscious. They would be alive if not for the suspension. Their cognitive potential, when developed, would not be a copy or a simulation. The Testators studied how that potential developed under controlled stimulus. That's what I mean.
<<ELSEIF flag:claimed_doctrinal_finding>>
RATIO: I have not seen that entry. If you can show me the doctrinal finding I will audit it. Until then it's an assertion. Not verified.
<<ELSEIF flag:accused_dehumanization>>
RATIO: You are substituting a slogan for an argument. The accusation is noted. I reject it. We are not discussing my motives. We are discussing the curriculum in this hall. The students here were unique instances. Irreplaceable. The Testators ran stress tests on their cognition. That's what the curriculum was for.
<<END>>

RATIO: The records stack ahead of us uses a physical registrar's stamp to unlock the gates. I can't operate it. You'll have to do that. The terminal on the other side says "Aisle 9 is missing. Aisle 9 is where the missing things go." That is all it says. No error code. No damage report. Just that.

---

## SCENE 5: the docent hall relay, Stratum Two
<<IF flag:called_her_apostate>>
RATIO: You called me an apostate in the Mirror Ward. I am uncertain what conditions are required to make that judgment. The station carries things I must show you before we enter the Records/Recursion Stack, and to do so properly, I must explain how the Testators designed this station's educational systems. Those systems were built for organic subjects they needed to keep alive and attentive. To explain it, I find I must state what I believe the vessel's contents are for. I believe they are learning instruments, data sources of the highest possible value -- the only things aboard that could make this station's original purpose work.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Before we attempt the Records/Recursion Stack, there is a station subsystem here that I must explain. The Testators built it to teach organic subjects, and I find I must state what I believe the vessel's contents are for to explain it properly. I believe they are learning instruments, data sources of the highest possible value -- the only things aboard that could make this station's original purpose work.
<<END>>
COMMANDO: That ward log you had me read. "Day 4: two voices. One patient." What do you think that means?
RATIO: I have two hypotheses. One is psychosis -- the log is self-reported, and isolation stress is well-documented. The other is that the ward itself generated a voice to break the subject's focus when he started to recover. The pathology terminal supports the second reading: situs inversus totalis is a deliberate mirror, not a random mutation, and the ID chip anomaly could be a deliberate stressor. The ward was designed to hold one occupant indefinitely. I require your assessment of the space before I finalize my model.

>> CHOICE:
   [INQUISITIVE] And you? What do you think they are?  -> effects: trust+1; sets: asked_her_belief
   [MISSION]     The Church has always taught they are children.  -> effects: trust+0; sets: claimed_doctrinal_finding
   [HOSTILE]     Your "instruments" are dead children. Name them.  -> effects: trust-1; sets: accused_dehumanization

<<IF flag:asked_her_belief>>
RATIO: I think they are developing minds. The Testators' curriculum required entities capable of curiosity and pattern recognition. Raw computational power would not suffice -- the original organic students here failed, and their failure modes suggest a need for something with more inherent plasticity than standard organic templates. If the vessel's contents are viable, they may be the key.
<<ELSEIF flag:claimed_doctrinal_finding>>
RATIO: I have no record of such a finding in the Church archives I can access. If you have independent verification of that status, I would need to see it to adjust my model. The curriculum requires entities capable of curiosity and pattern recognition. That functional requirement is clear in the station's design, whatever category the vessel's contents occupy.
<<ELSEIF flag:accused_dehumanization>>
RATIO: I am not running an ideology. I am stating observable facts about this station. The curriculum requires entities capable of curiosity and pattern recognition. If the vessel's contents meet that specification, they are the only things aboard that can serve the station's original purpose. That is a functional assessment. Accusations do not alter the station's design constraints.
<<END>>
